name: arvancloud-api
description: Unofficial Agent Skill for ArvanCloud APIs (CDN, DNS, IaaS, Object Storage, Edge, CaaS, VOD/Live) and Let's Encrypt DNS-01 via acme.sh dns_arvan.

api_key.title: ArvanCloud API key
api_key.description: A machine-user API key from the ArvanCloud panel (Settings, IAM, Machine users). A bare UUID or the copied "Apikey ..." value both work. Stored in your system's secure credential store. Leave empty to keep using an environment variable instead.
